text:
Alex G: Heads-up — customer (NordTech EU) just tried to return signed orderform and DocuSign rejected it due to an AML clause we didn't expect. Legal needs SCCs + DPA ack before countersign, Procurement wants net30 on PO. Can we route this and keep the POC timeline?
Maria R: envelope id `env_0a9b3f` — I saw the rejection email. Customer is pressing for a signed PO by EOW.
Jamal K: Customer contact is Lina @ NordTech — they're blocked on procurement internally. If we slip this week the POC kickoff shifts. Any workaround?
Docusign Bot: System notice: Envelope `env_0a9b3f` failed recipient validation — reason: "AML_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED". See https://docusign.example/envelopes/env_0a9b3f
Jen L (Legal): Can you paste the redlined clause that triggered AML? I need the snippet to propose edits to the MSA/DPA/SCC matrix.
Alex G: Pasting snippet from their procurement redline: "Seller must disclose ultimate beneficial owners and AML reports upon signing or PO execution" — their legal added this to the orderform attachment.
Sam P (Procurement): We usually accept ABC bank attestation + standard supplier KYC. Asking for UBO disclosure is a no-go for us. We need to confirm if NordTech is asking for 3rd-party audits or just sign-off.
Maria R: Quick suggestion: can Legal approve a one-off amendment that removes the UBO disclosure requirement and keeps AML due-diligence to onboarding only? If so we can re-send via DocuSign admin account. :thinking_face:
Jen L (Legal): Likely yes. I'll draft a narrow amendment: 1) remove UBO disclosure from the orderform, 2) require AML docs during onboarding (not at signing), 3) keep SCCs + DPA as-is. I need the customer's redline PDF.
Jamal K: Uploaded the PDF to the shared drive: https://redwood.drive/nordtech/poc/orderform-redline.pdf — ping Jen when done. Customer willing to accept amendment if we can turn around within 48h.
Maria R: If Legal signs the amendment, DocuSign sometimes still blocks on recipient verification. Ops workaround: change recipient verification from ID check to email-only for this envelope, then require AML on onboarding via checklist. That's what we did for BetaCorp.
Jen L (Legal): OK I'll draft now. Jen L (Legal) -> Maria R and Sam P: please include the exact language you want removed/kept so I can make the amendment precise.
Sam P (Procurement): Remove clause starting with "Seller must disclose ultimate beneficial owners" and replace with: "Seller shall provide commercially reasonable AML documentation as part of onboarding; disclosure of UBOs is subject to applicable law and company policy."
Maria R: Also add payment term change: PO to net30 (customer insists). Can we accept net30 for POC order of $25k? Finance flagged but Sales says needed for the deal.
Alex G: Finance check: we can approve net30 for POC under a one-time internal approval. I'll request it now — pls include total and quote id.
Maria R: Quote: `Q-2026-7742`, amount $25,000. I'll attach to the amendment.
Jen L (Legal): Draft done — attaching amendment text in-thread for quick review:
```
Amendment: Order Form AML and Payment Terms
1) Replace clause requiring UBO disclosure with: "Seller shall provide commercially reasonable AML documentation during onboarding; UBO disclosure only if required by law."
2) Payment Terms: Net 30 for PO `PO-NT-334` for amount $25,000.
3) All other terms including DPA and SCCs remain unchanged.
```
Maria R: LGTM from ops side. Sam P: procurement ok?
Sam P (Procurement): OK from procurement. We'll send vendor setup tokens after countersign.
Docusign Bot: Note: To avoid recipient ID checks re: `env_0a9b3f`, admin must re-create envelope with recipient verification set to "email". Contact `docs-admin@redwood.ai` if you need the admin resend.
Alex G: Action items: Jen to finalize amendment and attach redline; Maria to recreate envelope with email-only verification; Sam to confirm net30 internal approval; Alex to ping Finance for final sign-off.
Jen L (Legal): I'll send final PDF to `docs-admin@redwood.ai` + `lina@nordtech.com` once signatures are ready. Expecting to re-send within 6 hours. :thumbsup:
Jamal K: Thanks — looping in Lina on the thread for transparency. Lina, we'll re-send the corrected docs shortly.
Maria R: pinging `docs-admin@redwood.ai` now to reserve a DocuSign admin slot.
Alex G: Great teamwork — keep me posted if DocuSign bounces again.
Jamal K: I'll update the customer timeline: provisional kickoff remains but subject to final countersign.
